{"status": "NO_PLAN", "reasons": ["CS4223 requires CS3210, CS3220, or CG3207. CS3220 is not offered. CS3210 requires CS2100 (completed) or CG2028/EE2028/CG2007/EE2024. CG2028 requires no engineering prereqs but is a 4MC course. CG3207 requires EE2026 and (CG2028 or EE2028). EE2026 requires (EE1111A/B/EE2111A/CG1111A) and CS1010E/CS1010. None of these engineering prerequisites are completed. Thus CG3207 is not eligible. CG2028 is eligible. If CG2028 is taken, CS3210 becomes eligible. However, CG2028 is not in the list of 'must take' courses. Rule 8 states: 'Add a course the student did not ask for ONLY when it is a prerequisite needed by a planned course.' CS4223 is a must-take course. It needs CS3210 (or others). CS3210 needs CG2028 (or others). So CG2028 must be added. But CG2028 is 4MC. The student has an 8MC limit. Adding CG2028 consumes a slot. Let's see if a plan exists with CG2028. Must-takes: CS4223, CS4222, CS3237, CS2102, ES2660, CS2101. Plus CG2028. Total 7 courses. ES2660 in Sem 8. CS4222 (Sem 2 only) must be in Sem 6 or 8. Sem 8 is ES2660. So CS4222 in Sem 6. CS4223 (Sem 1 only) must be in Sem 5 or 7. CS3237 (Sem 1 only) must be in Sem 5 or 7. CS2101 (Sem 1,2) can be Sem 5,6,7. CS2102 (Sem 1,2) can be Sem 5,6,7. CG2028 (Sem 1,2) can be Sem 5,6,7. CS2101 as early as possible -> Sem 5. CS2102 as late as possible -> Sem 7. CS4223 must be after CS2101. So CS4223 in Sem 7 (since Sem 5 is taken by CS2101 and CS4223 needs strict earlier prereq, and CS2101 is in Sem 5, CS4223 can be Sem 6 or 7. But CS4223 is Sem 1 only, so Sem 5 or 7. Sem 5 is same semester as CS2101, so CS4223 cannot be Sem 5 if CS2101 is Sem 5? No, CS2101 is not a prereq for CS4223. CS2101 is just a constraint 'CS2101 must come before CS4223'. This means Sem(CS2101) < Sem(CS4223). If CS2101 is Sem 5, CS4223 can be Sem 6 or 7. But CS4223 is Sem 1 only, so Sem 5 or 7. Sem 5 is not > Sem 5. So CS4223 must be Sem 7. So CS4223 in Sem 7. CS2102 as late as possible. Sem 7 is taken by CS4223. Can CS2102 be in Sem 7? Sem 7 limit 8MC (2 modules). CS4223 is 4MC. CS2102 is 4MC. So Sem 7 can hold CS4223 and CS2102. This satisfies 'CS2102 as late as possible' (Sem 7 is later than Sem 5 or 6). So CS2102 in Sem 7. Now we have CS2101 (Sem 5), CS4222 (Sem 6), CS4223 (Sem 7), CS2102 (Sem 7), ES2660 (Sem 8). Remaining must-takes: CS3237, CG2028. CS3237 (Sem 1 only) -> Sem 5 or 7. Sem 7 is full (CS4223, CS2102). So CS3237 must be Sem 5. Sem 5 has CS2101. Can take one more (8MC). So CS3237 in Sem 5. Now Sem 5: CS2101, CS3237. Sem 6: CS4222. Sem 7: CS4223, CS2102. Sem 8: ES2660. Remaining: CG2028. CG2028 (Sem 1,2) -> Sem 5, 6, 7. Sem 5 is full (8MC). Sem 7 is full (8MC). Sem 6 has CS4222 (4MC). Can take one more (4MC). So CG2028 in Sem 6. Sem 6: CS4222, CG2028. Check prerequisites: CS4223 needs CS3210 or CG3207. CS3210 needs CS2100 (done) or CG2028 (done in Sem 6). CS4223 is in Sem 7. CG2028 is in Sem 6. Sem 6 < Sem 7. So CS3210 is eligible in Sem 7? No, CS3210 is not taken. CS4223 prereq is (CS2106 or CG2271) AND (CS3210 or CS3220 or CG3207). CS2106 is done. CS3210 is NOT taken. The student did not ask for CS3210. Rule 8 says add a course ONLY when it is a prerequisite needed by a planned course. CS4223 is planned. It needs CS3210 (or CG3207). CG3207 needs EE2026 (not eligible). So CS3210 is needed. CS3210 needs CG2028 (or others). CG2028 is needed. So we must add CS3210 and CG2028. I added CG2028. Did I add CS3210? No. CS4223 requires CS3210. CS3210 is not in the plan. So CS4223's prerequisite is not met. To fix this, CS3210 must be added. CS3210 is 4MC. Where can it go? Sem 5 is full. Sem 6 is full (CS4222, CG2028). Sem 7 is full (CS4223, CS2102). Sem 8 is ES2660. No space for CS3210. Thus, no plan exists.

["CS4223 requires CS3210, which requires CG2028. Adding both CS3210 and CG2028 exceeds the 8 MC limit in all available semesters (5, 6, 7) given the other mandatory courses and constraints."]}
